title: Nesting depth from a spec
prompt: A log line encodes nested calls with `<` for *call* and `>` for *return*. Compute the **maximum nesting depth** reached. If at any point a `>` occurs when nothing is open (or the log ends with calls still open), the log is malformed: return **-1**. An empty log is well-formed with depth 0. Implement `depth(String log)`.

tests.name: depth incl. malformed
tests.hint: One pass: increment on '<', decrement on '>', track max, fail if count ever negative or final count not zero.
